# [TASK] Setup Gradle Multi-Module Build

## Task
Configure the root Gradle build so all 9 backend modules share one Java
toolchain, one set of Spring Boot and Spring Cloud versions, and one
coverage setup.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `settings.gradle` includes exactly the 9 backend modules
      (`ProjectStructureTest.settingsGradleIncludesExactlyTheNineBackendModules`)
- [x] The Java toolchain is pinned at the root and inherited by every module
      (`ProjectStructureTest.javaToolchainIsPinnedAtTheRoot`, currently Java 25)
- [x] Spring Boot and Spring Cloud versions come from root
      `gradle.properties` through `io.spring.dependency-management`
      (`./gradlew :backend:movie-service:dependencies`)
- [x] JaCoCo applies to every module from the root build
      (Backend CI step `./gradlew jacocoTestReport`)
- [x] Every module compiles against the shared toolchain and dependency set
      (Backend CI step `./gradlew clean build -x test`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 5

## Notes
The last criterion recorded a one-off build on 2025-11-14. Replaced with
the Backend CI step that runs the same build on every push.

`shared-library` is consumed by 6 services. `discovery-service` and
`config-service` do not depend on it, which is deliberate: a Eureka server
and a Spring Cloud Config server hold no domain code.
